source-integrity.provenance: issuer quarterly/results and product/acquisition disclosures plus independent S&P-derived market data
source-integrity.freshness: Q2 results 2026-08-05; roadmap/acquisition outlook 2026-09-08; market data 2026-09-21
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: issuer releases remain issuer-origin evidence and are not counted as independent corroboration
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: market valuation origin is distinct from issuer evidence; technical/product claims remain primarily issuer-sourced
source-integrity.rawDerivedConsistency: packet growth/RPO, roadmap and acquisition-risk claims are consistent with cited lineage; valuation is independently sourced

company-underwriting.financialOperatingTrajectory: Revenue and RPO growth are strong, but commercialization remains early and acquisition effects complicate organic attribution; losses remain substantial.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Liquidity is substantial, but share count increased materially and acquisition-led expansion raises capital-allocation and dilution risk.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: System deployments and expanding RPO demonstrate contracted demand, while useful fault-tolerant workload economics remain unproven.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Management is pursuing vertical integration and acquisitions; execution breadth is increasing but disciplined long-duration returns are not yet demonstrated.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: High technical differentiation may support future pricing, but current evidence does not demonstrate durable scarcity rent or workload-level economic advantage.
company-underwriting.catalysts: Superion 256 rollout, integrated SkyWater manufacturing and RPO conversion are identifiable catalysts.
risks: competing quantum modalities and classical accelerators

thesisQuality.basis: Rapid commercial/RPO growth and manufacturing integration support a credible thesis, but useful fault-tolerant economics and independent performance validation remain unproven.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Revenue/RPO expansion is strong, but losses remain large and acquisition contribution makes organic momentum less certain.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: About $16.09B market cap and $14.03B enterprise value against roughly $246.5M TTM revenue imply a very demanding valuation while profitability is absent.

catalystScore.basis: Superion rollout, SkyWater integration and contracted RPO conversion are identifiable near/medium-term catalysts, though technical and economic validation remains incomplete.

governancePower.basis: Management has expanded platform scope and manufacturing control, but acquisition intensity, losses and dilution leave capital-allocation quality mixed.

alignment2036.basis: Quantum computing, networking and sensing address durable strategic compute/security needs, while timing of economically useful fault tolerance remains uncertain.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Computing, networking, sensing and foundry/manufacturing capabilities provide several demand channels sharing a quantum platform.

bottleneckControl.basis: Vertical fabrication and trapped-ion system integration create meaningful control of manufacturability, but fault tolerance and economic utility remain unresolved system bottlenecks.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Platform breadth provides optionality, but the investment thesis remains highly dependent on quantum adoption, roadmap execution and workload-level advantage.

substitutionResilience.basis: Trapped-ion differentiation exists, but rival quantum modalities and classical accelerators remain credible substitutes until economic advantage is independently demonstrated.

supplyChainResilience.basis: SkyWater integration can improve domestic manufacturing control, but production yield, redundancy and critical-component resilience are not yet demonstrated.

pricingPower.basis: Technical differentiation and contracted demand exist, but current evidence does not establish durable price pass-through or scarcity rent across cycles.

riskEvidence.basis: Very high valuation, persistent losses, dilution, acquisition integration, technical roadmap uncertainty and credible substitutes create high risk despite liquidity and growth.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current issuer evidence supports financial, RPO and roadmap facts and independent market data supports valuation; independent technical benchmarks, production yields and organic/acquisition attribution remain incomplete.

scoreRecord.thesis: IonQ has real commercial growth and increasingly integrated quantum manufacturing, but the present valuation prices substantial technical and economic success before fault-tolerant workload economics are independently proven.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Roadmap or useful-economic-advantage shortfalls could compress a valuation already far ahead of current revenue and profitability.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Superion deployment, SkyWater manufacturing integration and RPO conversion into recognized revenue with evidence of organic demand and improving economics.

contradictions.item: Rapid revenue/RPO growth coexists with acquisition effects and an early fault-tolerant commercialization curve.

unknowns.item: Independent Superion performance validation and production yields remain unestablished.
Workload-level fault-tolerant economic advantage remains unproven.
